article.title: Certis以巡查案例說明人員、機械人及AI的分工
article.summary: Certis公布Built for What's Next品牌活動，以巡查機械人與營運平台說明技術如何支援前線人員。
highlights: 公司列出Wallace巡查及Mozart整合營運資訊的角色。
新加坡榜鵝數碼園區是試點場景之一。
article.why: 企業服務品牌可用可指認的工作場景解釋AI用途，並說明由誰作決定。
article.next_step: 選一項前線工作，畫出人員、裝置及系統的交接，再用同一案例測試銷售說明。
article.detail: Certis把機械人巡查和營運協調放進品牌故事。公司稱Wallace用於巡查，Mozart把資料及工作流程匯集供團隊處理，重要決定仍由人員作出。新加坡榜鵝數碼園區是公司列舉的試點之一。團隊可參考案例對照品牌文案中的每項職責是否有現場例子。試點的結論應按場地分開記錄。
article.title_en: Certis uses a patrol case to show the roles of staff, robots and AI
article.summary_en: Certis launched Built for What's Next, illustrating how patrol robots and operations tools support front-line staff.
highlights_en: The company describes Wallace patrols and Mozart's role in connecting operations information.
Singapore's Punggol Digital District is a named testbed.
article.why_en: B2B services brands can explain AI through named tasks and show who makes decisions.
article.next_step_en: Map handoffs between people, devices and systems for one task and use the same case in sales materials.
article.detail_en: Certis brings robot patrols and operations coordination into its brand story. It says Wallace patrols sites and Mozart connects data and workflows for teams, with people retaining key decisions. Punggol Digital District is one named testbed in Singapore. Check that each role in the campaign has a concrete example. Keep pilot findings specific to each site.
